verdict.rationale: Asana offers AI-driven workflow tools (AI Teammates, AI Studio no-code automations, rule actions/webhooks) that could be configured to triage and prioritize tasks, but no evidence specifically documents an out-of-the-box 'triage incoming bugs' capability or automatic prioritization logic — it would require custom setup via AI Studio/rules. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic bug/task triage or prioritization workflows, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that this works as described.
